author: felipeblassioli
abstract: Verify whether a GitHub issue is implemented in the current codebase by collecting evidence from the issue, git history, docs, code, and tests, then producing a structured report with verdict, proof, gaps, confidence, and scope-clarity doubts. Use when the user asks whether an issue was resolved or whether a branch or PR truly satisfies an issue. Strictly observational; does not fix code or plan implementation.
